作者挺惨的，我之前没看见，看完也考虑要不要搬运（https://www.fanbox.cc/@spoiledmuffin/posts/10525123），后来想想EH应该还是有不少人愿意为正版付费的，我也是看了盗版以后才会考虑入正，如果看了觉得不错且有能力的话希望大家能支持下作者，非常感谢。
PIXIV漫画部分的长图都没有传,短图也有些没粘。X部分和FANBOX/PIXIV可能有重合，实在没精力挨张对了。种子里FANBOX部分命名为999的是作者用图片生成的AI视频，无法上传所以放到种子里。以后每个月尽量都出2000日元或等额港币买点正版（主要是没时间，我都是一张张粘的，找不到好用的爬虫软件），图片集和漫画都行，但漫画的话我没能力翻译，有推荐的可以评论区发下。

The author has had a rough time; I hadn't noticed the situation earlier, and after seeing it, I debated whether to repost the content (https://www.fanbox.cc/@spoiledmuffin/posts/10525123). However, I figured there are likely plenty of people on EH willing to pay for the official version—after all, I only considered buying the official release after seeing the pirated version myself. If you like the work and have the means, I hope you’ll consider supporting the author. Thank you very much.
I didn't upload the long-format images from the Pixiv manga section, and some of the shorter images were also omitted. There may be overlap between the "X" (Twitter) content and the Fanbox/Pixiv material, but I simply didn't have the energy to cross-reference every single image. In the torrent, the files named "999" within the Fanbox section are AI-generated videos created by the author; since they couldn't be uploaded directly, I included them in the torrent instead.From now on, I’ll try to spend around 2,000 JPY (or the equivalent in HKD) each month on official releases—mostly because I lack the time; I’ve been stitching images together manually since I haven't found a good web scraper. I’m open to both art books and manga, though I don't have the ability to translate manga myself. If you have any recommendations, feel free to post them in the comments.
